# ws — commands

<!-- generated by tools/gen-docs.mjs from upstream onchainos 4.6.3; do not edit -->
Real-time WebSocket subscriptions for DEX data. Required flags are in the signature; `ocl ws <cmd> --help` prints the full upstream help.

### ws channels
List all supported WebSocket channels
`ocl ws channels`

### ws channel-info
Show detailed info for a specific channel
`ocl ws channel-info --channel <CHANNEL>`

### ws start
Start a background WebSocket session and return its ID
`ocl ws start [options]`
- `--channel <CHANNEL>` (repeatable) — Channel(s) to subscribe, e.g. --channel kol_smartmoney-tracker-activity
- `--wallet-addresses <WALLET_ADDRESSES>` — Wallet addresses for address-tracker-activity, comma-separated (max 200)
- `--chain-index <CHAIN_INDEX>` — Chain index(es) for per-chain channels, comma-separated (e.g. 1,501,56)
- `--token-pair <TOKEN_PAIR>` — Token pair(s) for per-token channels: chainIndex:tokenAddress, comma-separated
- `--env <ENV>` — Environment: prod (default) or pre (default prod)
- `--idle-timeout <IDLE_TIMEOUT>` — Auto-stop if no poll within this duration (default: 30m, 0 to disable) (default 30m)

### ws poll
Poll incremental events from a running session
`ocl ws poll --id <ID> [options]`
- `--channel <CHANNEL>` — Channel to poll
- `--limit <LIMIT>` — Maximum number of events to return (default: 20) (default 20)
- `--min-quote-amount <MIN_QUOTE_AMOUNT>` — Filter (tracker only): min quoteTokenAmount
- `--min-market-cap <MIN_MARKET_CAP>` — Filter (tracker only): min marketCap (USD)
- `--min-pnl <MIN_PNL>` — Filter (tracker only): min realizedPnlUsd (set 0 for profit-only)
- `--trader <TRADER>` — Filter (tracker only): walletAddress prefix match
- `--tag <TAG>` — Filter (tracker only): smart_money (1) or kol (2)
- `--since <SINCE>` — Filter (tracker only): tradeTime >= this ms timestamp
- `--trade-type <TRADE_TYPE>` — Filter (tracker only): buy or sell

### ws stop
Stop a running session
`ocl ws stop [options]`
- `--id <ID>` — Session ID to stop
- `--flush` — Return any unread events before stopping

### ws list
List all sessions
`ocl ws list`

### ws run-daemon
Internal: run daemon event loop (not for direct use) _(hidden upstream)_
`ocl ws run-daemon --id <ID>`
